medicalReason.emergencyText: Online consultations are not for emergencies. If you have chest pain, difficulty breathing, severe bleeding, signs of stroke, thoughts of self-harm or another urgent problem, call 998 (Ambulance) or 999 now, or go to the nearest emergency department.
medicalReason.ackEmergency: I confirm this is not an emergency and I understand the doctor may refer me to in-person or emergency care.
medicalReason.ackTelehealth: I consent to a remote video consultation with a DHA-licensed doctor and understand its limitations (no physical examination; narcotic and controlled medicines cannot be prescribed online).
medicalReason.ackPrivacy: I consent to DocNow processing and storing my personal and health information to provide this consultation, and to it being recorded in my medical record.
medicalReason.consentRequired: Please confirm all three statements to continue.
